scope: Official v2 canonical catalog (110) only. Rounds v3,4,5 proposed assets excluded from all capacity arithmetic.

known_gaps.reason: No canonically selected runtime/software resources, no complete ABI/OS/driver/backend dependency closure.
License versions, withdrawal history, source SHA provenance and approvals are required to make a durable archive lawful and interpretable.
No confirmed dedicated security-defense model in canonical selection; security taxonomy is overly broad.
Audio/video generation coverage does not imply ability to verify provenance or identify synthetic edits.
Chronos-2 does not replace geophysical or multispectral spatiotemporal pretrained weights.
Robotic policy runtime, world simulation and license-cleared behavior datasets are not interchangeable.
Protein generation and genome autoregressive pretraining differ from medical dialogue and static representation.

targeted_new_research_candidates.reason: 攻撃的プロンプト分類専用の保護モデル。現行safety_securityタグは拒否方向編集であって独立したプロンプト防御器ではない。公開ゲートが現存し、攻撃のリスクに対応する防御側の研究資産。
targeted_new_research_candidates.blockers: Meta利用条件、言語/攻撃種類、評価時誤検知、model cardの名前とパラメータ表示が一致するかを確認。政府による制限予定ではない。

recommended_actions: Freeze new high-volume additions pending exact file lists, original checkpoints and dependency sizes.
Resolve license/access rights of existing R0 assets before capacity commitments.
Audit 10 largest active models (top five occupy about 0.992TB in all-repo source view) and evaluate whether all alternate variants need preservation.
Separate durable artifact kinds: model/dataset/runtime/license-provenance, without making model count growth the objective.
For future approvals require selected file byte counts, complete rev hashes, official file hashes, dependencies and offline backend assumptions. Rounds 4 and 5 remain proposals, not counted.
uncertainties: All selected_file_bytes and fully_pinned_revision_sha are missing in current 110-item catalog; reported 3.234TB is not a final acquisition manifest.

Full repo includes alternate formats/checkpoints and thus may overestimate selected files, while uncounted runtime dependencies, staged temporary copies and legal-metadata storage can increase real footprint.
The empty approved queue does not prove that the user's HDD is empty; no physical HDD access or byte measurement took place.
No model-specific prediction of government regulation or removal has been established.
